timeline.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant — Pulsed Laser Template Engineering (PLATEN)
timeline.org: Center for Quantum Research and Technology (CQRT), University of Oklahoma
timeline.body: Cleanroom semiconductor nanofabrication: photolithography, reactive ion etching and pulsed laser deposition to build and evaluate high-aspect-ratio micro- and nanostructures. Tune anisotropic plasma etch parameters — gas chemistry, RF power, chamber pressure — for vertical sidewalls and controlled feature depth, and support process development from resist patterning through etch selectivity to post-process inspection.

timeline.title: Electrical Systems Member
timeline.body: Developed CAD layouts in Onshape for electrical component placement, wire routing and electromechanical integration, balancing signal integrity against thermal and mechanical constraints, and designed the robot’s power distribution architecture.

timeline.title: Research Apprentice — Light–Matter Interaction (Dr. Tischler)
timeline.org: Center for Quantum Research and Technology (CQRT), University of Oklahoma
timeline.body: Conducted systematic literature reviews of quantum optical phenomena in silicon carbide and wide-bandgap semiconductor nanocrystals, building a materials-level foundation for next-generation photonics, and worked alongside the optical spectroscopy systems used to characterise them.

timeline.title: Research Apprentice — Cloud Microphysics (Dr. McFarquhar)
timeline.org: National Weather Center, University of Oklahoma
timeline.body: Analysed high-resolution aircraft datasets to characterise cloud microphysical properties, running end-to-end data processing, atmospheric profile modelling and visualisation in Python (NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib).

timeline.title: B.S. Electrical & Computer Engineering (Honors)
timeline.body: Minor in Mathematics and Computer Science. GPA 4.0. Coursework in analog electronics, semiconductor devices, signals and systems, and electromagnetics, with self-directed work in analog IC design on the sky130 open PDK alongside it.
